switches.name: BASICRHI_DX12_SUBMIT_LOG
switches.description: 1: each D3D12 queue's last 64 submissions in the stall report

switches.name: CS_DCLF
switches.description: 0: DCLF does not install

switches.name: CS_DCLF_ASYNC_COMPUTE
switches.description: 0: the passes that prefer the compute queue (build-draws' queries, fades, portal batches, tree wind) run on the graphics queue; unset: on in guest mode, off in native mode (1 turns it on there)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_BILLBOARD_PARTICLES
switches.description: default on (T7f item 7): particle systems under NiBillboardNodes (the magic hands' fire cores and embers) drawn by DCLF's particle path like any other (their world and particles are their last update's); 0 they stay the engine's (billboard)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_CAPTURE
switches.description: <dir>: D3D12 native only. Records every view, sampler and pipeline; the cs-test command dclf:capture then dumps one frame of DCLF's Z-prepass and main opaque passes into <dir>/capture-<frame>/ for pascal-fetch-bench replay (docs/development/plans/dclf-replay.md)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_CAPTURE_PARITY
switches.description: 1: the tables against the engine's own lighting draws (run with CS_DCLF_PARITY_BOTH=1, so the engine draws what DCLF draws)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_CPU_BATCH
switches.description: the CPU pipeline's batch lanes (default 4096, rounded up to a multiple of 8; the live setting's seed: dclf:cpu-batch, the menu)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_CPU_RECORD
switches.description: indirect|serial (default indirect on every vendor): the CPU pipeline's per-frame views as indirect draws the cull jobs write, or direct draws DXVK's CS thread records (live toggle's seed)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_CULL
switches.description: off|frustum|occlusion (default): GPU culling, the live toggle's seed

switches.name: CS_DCLF_EFFECT_CLOUD_LIGHT
switches.description: default on: effect meshes with kEffectLighting and kCloudLOD (lit by the cloud light, not the sun) drawn by DCLF with the cloud light's colour as a frame row; 0 they stay native (cloud-lighting)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_EFFECT_FALLOFF
switches.description: default on: effect meshes with Falloff and no blending alpha property (the engine's hint 1, unblended while their alpha is one) drawn by DCLF's forward epoch unblended, sorted with the blended objects; 0 they stay native (effect-opaque)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_EFFECT_RIGID_SKINS
switches.description: 1: effect meshes with a skin instance whose pass has no Skinned bit (the property without kSkinned: dog eyes) drawn by DCLF, each partition with the unskinned vertex stage and the geometry's world, as the engine draws them; 0 (default) they stay native (effect-variant (skinned))

switches.name: CS_DCLF_EMPTY_FADE_NODE
switches.description: default on (T7f item 7): the engine's empty fade node (the BSFadeNode 0x14332a2a0 holds, which every BSShaderProperty starts with and the engine reads as none) is no fade root: such geometry (terrain, object LOD, some clutter) takes its entry's root; 0: it is listed as one fade root of all of them, outside the scene graph

switches.name: CS_DCLF_FIRST_PERSON_DECALS
switches.description: default on (T7f item 7): a decal on a first-person entry (an effect's skinned blood decal on the arms, a weapon's BloodLighting) drawn by the first-person forward part as a forward object with its decal group's depth bias, test and blend; 0 it stays the engine's

switches.name: CS_DCLF_HEAP_FRAME_BLOCKS
switches.description: 1: D3D12 pulled stages read the pass-wide frame blocks by heap index instead of a bound descriptor table (A/B for dclf-bound-constants.md)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_LATE_POSE
switches.description: 0: the player's parts Improved Camera hides after the shadow maps are not looked for; 1: they are looked for in first person without the plugin too

switches.name: CS_DCLF_LOD_GATES
switches.description: 0: the engine's LOD swaps ungated (T6b5: by default an object or terrain LOD swap keeps the outgoing level shown, and the incoming hidden, until DCLF's claims cover the incoming)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_MASTER_PARTICLES
switches.description: default on: the particle manager's master particle systems (torches, candles, street mist, blood impacts) tracked as DCLF's unheld roots, their particle systems drawn by DCLF's particle path (dclf-roadmap.md 1.4); 0 they stay the engine's

switches.name: CS_DCLF_OPAQUE_EFFECTS
switches.description: default on (T7f item 7): opaque BSEffectShaderProperty meshes (hint 0: no blending alpha property, no Falloff, depth tested and written; forge coals, slag) drawn by DCLF in the G-buffer with the DEFERRED effect variant, through the opaque decal group's fixed slots and its decal depth pass without the bias; 0 they stay the engine's (effect-opaque)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PARITY
switches.description: 1: set parity (the claims against the engine's registrations, and the visibility words read back after the colour epoch against the CPU's decisions), the kept stores against a rebuild every 60 frames, and the scene mirror against the live objects every frame

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PARITY_BOTH
switches.description: 1: nothing is withheld from the engine, which draws everything while DCLF draws its set as well (capture parity compares the two; it double-draws)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PASS_STATS
switches.description: 1: per-pass counts in the report

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PIPELINE
switches.description: auto (default: exteriors GPU-driven, interiors CPU-driven)|manual|gpu|cpu: the draws culled and recorded on the GPU, or culled on the CPU and recorded as direct draws into DXVK's command buffer; gpu and cpu are manual with both kinds of cell (live toggle's seed)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PIPELINE_PRECOMPILE
switches.description: 0: no startup pipeline step; each DCLF pipeline builds when first drawn (the pipeline manifest is still read and saved)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PLAIN_SNOW_SPARKLE
switches.description: 0: a snow layer whose material is the plain class draws without sparkle instead of the Snow class's default (live toggle's seed)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PLAYER_PARITY
switches.description: 1: the compatibility monitor starts on (the menu switches it live): engine state other plugins change with no hook DCLF sees, by reference and plugin

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PORTAL_EVALUATOR
switches.description: Portal batches' evaluation: inline (one dispatch, the default) or batched (by program: count, scan, scatter, evaluate)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PORTAL_TRACE
switches.description: Inline portal batches write each query's decision trace

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PORTAL_UNIFORM_SCAN
switches.description: Evaluate portal batches with the diagnostic uniform instruction scan

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PROFILE
switches.description: 1: scene-phase timings in the report

switches.name: CS_DCLF_PROGRAM_MANIFEST
switches.description: 0: the engine draw families queue none of the program manifest's keys at setup, so each program builds at its first draw, as on a cold shader store's first run (the manifest is still read and saved)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_RELEASE_GUARD
switches.description: 1: the engine objects' last releases on DCLF's threads (the scene lane, the pool) counted and named by class (NiRefObject::DeleteThis patched; T6b3e)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_SCENE_COPIES
switches.description: the copies a frame's scene values keep per pool class (FrameValues' rows; default 3, 2 to the frames in flight): a frame's producer reuses the copy the oldest in-flight frame bound, its uploads waiting on the GPU for that frame

switches.name: CS_DCLF_SHADER_DEBUG
switches.description: default on (off in the release profile, 1 turns it on): SPIR-V with debug info, and the HLSL sources copied beside the log; 0: without

switches.name: CS_DCLF_SHADER_SOURCE_DIR
switches.description: where CS_DCLF_SHADER_DEBUG copies the HLSL sources

switches.name: CS_DCLF_SHRINK
switches.description: when the growable scene buffers give memory back (one policy for all, PooledBackings::Shrink): default once a buffer was asked at most a quarter of its capacity for 5 s; off: grow-only; eager: at the first such ask (stress and parity runs)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_STAGE_DUMP
switches.description: <dir>: every DCLF stage request's compile inputs, the Lighting programs' descriptor pairs and the pulled rewrite's options, as JSON lines in <dir>/stages.jsonl, for tools/shader-compare

switches.name: CS_DCLF_STATS
switches.description: 1: the periodic report

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TABLE_START
switches.description: small: the growable GPU tables start with a few rows, so that growth runs early and often

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TEX_DISTANCE
switches.description: 0: no distance floor (over the menu's setting)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TEX_FEEDBACK
switches.description: 0: no shader feedback (over the menu's setting)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TEX_STREAM
switches.description: 0: the game's textures stay whole, not shells with streamed mip windows; read at the first texture load

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TEX_STREAM_BASE
switches.description: the base window's largest side (default 128)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TEX_STREAM_BUDGET_MB
switches.description: the memory streaming keeps to, in MiB, above or below the driver's budget (default: the driver's budget)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TEX_STREAM_DELAY_MS
switches.description: a delay before each background window build, to see late windows

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TEX_STREAM_DISTANCE_SCALE
switches.description: the distance floor's sharpness: above 1 finer mips (default 1)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TEX_STREAM_FULL
switches.description: 1: every window the full chain, made as the texture loads (the baseline)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TEX_STREAM_RATE_MB
switches.description: upgrades started per second, in MiB (default 256)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TEX_STREAM_VISIBLE_OFFSET
switches.description: over the budget, how many mips what is on screen may step down (default 0: it loads what it asks for)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TREE_LIST_ALL
switches.description: 1 (T7f; off by default): the tree manager's list loop given DCLF's verdict for every BSTreeNode DCLF lists; off: the stood-in trees alone (T7b5's fix)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TREE_LOD_STAGES
switches.description: 1: each stage of the main tree LOD draws (depth and colour vertex and pixel stages) stamps the frame; frames a stage missed are logged

switches.name: CS_DCLF_TREE_LOD_TINT
switches.description: 1: DCLF's tree LOD colour draws write solid magenta, so screen captures find its pixels

switches.name: CS_DCLF_WATER
switches.description: 0: nothing of it is registered, and the latch path draws all water; 1: water shapes are DCLF scene objects: tracked under the water roots (WaterLOD, the water system's root), classified by the water port and counted by the water census, but not claimed, so the latch path still draws them (dclf-water-indirect.md, phase 1); 2 (default): as 1, and plain water is claimed and drawn by DCLF's water.mask and water.surface epochs in GPU-driven frames, the rest staying the latch path's (phases 2 and 3)

switches.name: CS_DCLF_WATER_PARITY
switches.description: 1: every water draw the latch path takes is checked against the water port (VS and PS b0-b2 bit for bit, its pass id), and a census logs where drawn water hangs in the scene graph (dclf-water-indirect.md, Phase 0)

switches.name: CS_DISABLE_FEATURES
switches.description: comma-separated feature short names disabled at boot (write [features] instead)

switches.name: CS_FXC_REQUEST_DUMP
switches.description: <folder>: one line per FXC request in fxc-requests.jsonl there, to repeat the build outside the game

switches.name: CS_GPA
switches.description: 1: GPUPerfAPI loads at startup (it must exist before the device)

switches.name: CS_GPU_COUNTERS_RANGES
switches.description: a headless run's hardware counter capture, queued once the counter backend is ready

switches.name: CS_GPU_COUNTERS_SAMPLES
switches.description: that capture's samples (default 3)

switches.name: CS_GPU_COUNTERS_START_FRAME
switches.description: the frame that capture starts at

switches.name: CS_GPU_EVENT_TIMERS
switches.description: <frames>: the GPU event timers on, their counts logged every that many frames

switches.name: CS_HANG_WATCHDOG
switches.description: seconds without progress before the hang watchdog writes its report (default 15)

switches.name: CS_ORG
switches.description: 0: the render graph is off; features: only its interop device features, without the graph

switches.name: CS_ORG_D3D12_INSTANCE_WORD
switches.description: 1: D3D12 DCLF draws pass the first instance in a root constant per draw, as before Shader Model 6.8's SV_StartInstanceLocation

switches.name: CS_ORG_DEFRAG
switches.description: native: compact ORG's device-local memory at loading screens (GraphHost::DefragmentAtIdle)

switches.name: CS_ORG_LLF_PARITY
switches.description: 1: the parity frame's D3D11 light culling against the render graph's, cluster by cluster

switches.name: CS_ORG_MISMATCH_FATAL
switches.description: 0: a frame anchor mismatch is not fatal (it is in every build but the Release profile)

switches.name: CS_ORG_NATIVE
switches.description: true: native mode, no DXVK; BasicRHI's device and ORG present (render-graph.md, "Native mode")

switches.name: CS_ORG_NATIVE_BACKEND
switches.description: native mode's backend; d3d12 needs org.native

switches.name: CS_ORG_NATIVE_VALIDATION
switches.description: true: BasicRHI's API validation in native mode (Vulkan layers or the D3D12 debug layer)

switches.name: CS_ORG_PIPELINE_CACHE
switches.description: false: no on-disk pipeline cache (Data/ShaderCache/v3/pipelines-*.bin); every pipeline is built again each run

switches.name: CS_ORG_RAW_ACCESS_CHECK
switches.description: native: log and count work on graph-tracked images that skips the graph's state tracking ([ORG raw access] lines)

switches.name: CS_ORG_TRIPWIRE_LOG
switches.description: 1: Tripwire logs every call site with its count

switches.name: CS_ORG_TRIPWIRE_LOG_INTERVAL
switches.description: seconds between Tripwire's call site reports (default 60)

switches.name: CS_ORG_VRAM_SOURCE
switches.description: org: ORG's allocator counts beside DXVK's memory, for the VRAM heaps and texture streaming's budget

switches.name: CS_SHADER_DXC
switches.description: a regular expression on <path>:<target>:<descriptor>: the shaders that build with DXC; empty: every shader with FXC

switches.name: CS_STREAMLINE_REFLEX
switches.description: 0: Streamline does not load Reflex, PCL or DLSS-G (for Nsight captures)

switches.name: CS_TEST_LIST_SWITCHES
switches.description: 1: the game writes CommunityShaders-Switches.json (every switch) at kPostPostLoad and exits

switches.name: CS_UPSCALE_SUBMIT
switches.description: direct: upscaling's ring submissions wait for DXVK's command stream

switches.name: CS_VRAM_DEBUG
switches.description: 1: the VRAM attribution's debug mode: creation call sites and ORG's allocation ledger

switches.name: DXVK_DEBUG
switches.description: DXVK's debug options (hang: its hang markers; DRED on D3D12)

switches.name: DXVK_FILTER_DEVICE_NAME
switches.description: DXVK uses only the adapter whose name contains this

switches.name: ORG_BOUND_PUSH_TABLES
switches.description: 0: D3D12 graph compute programs read every constant buffer from the heap (A/B for their bound push tables)

switches.name: ORG_FRAME_PLACEMENT
switches.description: true: ORG places graph transients across the whole frame (org-whole-frame-placement.md)

switches.name: ORG_FRAME_PLACEMENT_LOG
switches.description: true: log every frame-placement resource and slot

switches.name: ORG_RELOCATION_STRESS
switches.description: <n>: ORG moves n ReadOnly graph backings at each relocation commit, to test the follow path (org-relocation.md, step 3)

switches.name: VK_LOADER_LAYERS_DISABLE
switches.description: the Vulkan loader leaves out these layers (comma-separated globs)
